info.title: FacelessPro API
info.description:
Self-hosted faceless video generation — Tamil, English, Tanglish.

All endpoints under `/v1/` require `Authorization: Bearer vp_<40-hex>`.
MCP is at `/mcp` (Streamable HTTP + SSE) with the same key or OAuth 2.1.
Public artifacts are at `/files/<key>` without authentication.
